## Allegiant and Sun Country Announce All-New Nonstop Routes Ahead of Summer 2027 Travel Season


11/17/2026


*Allegiant to Join Sun Country in Serving Minneapolis-Saint Paul International Airport (MSP) and Sun Country to Begin Service in Three New Cities Starting Late Spring 2027*


LAS VEGAS


, Nov. 17, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- **Allegiant Travel Company** (NASDAQ: ALGT), parent company of Allegiant Air and recently acquired Sun Country Airlines, today announced a total of 16 new routes across both leisure carriers ahead of the summer 2027 travel season. The company also shared that each carrier, which continue to operate separately until 2028 or later, will add to their respective networks: Allegiant will serve passengers in the Twin Cities via Minneapolis-Saint Paul International Airport (MSP), and Sun Country will begin service in Belleville, Illinois via MidAmerica St. Louis Airport (BLV), Gulf Shores, Alabama via Gulf Shores International Airport at Jack Edwards Field (GUF), and Knoxville, Tennessee via McGhee Tyson Airport (TYS).


Launching in late spring 2027, the new routes will provide convenient nonstop service and expand each carrier's shared presence in popular leisure destinations nationwide. Allegiant and Sun Country, both known for bringing convenient and affordable nonstop service to leisure travelers, are leveraging their complementary networks to provide more customers with access to the destinations they want to visit most.


"Minnesota is an essential part of the future of our combined company, and today's announcement is another step in delivering on that commitment," said Greg Anderson, chief executive officer at Allegiant. "MSP is our largest base of operations by a wide margin, and we see opportunities for continued growth there. Combining Sun Country's strong foundation in the Twin Cities with Allegiant's nationwide network of communities will provide Minnesota travelers with more convenient, affordable nonstop travel options. Together, we're building the nation's leading leisure airline for customers throughout the United States."


While Allegiant and Sun Country continue to operate as separate carriers, customers should review each airline's respective policies, fees, schedules, and travel requirements when booking and preparing for travel. Airport locations, onboard services, and other amenities may vary by carrier.


"As we planned for summer 2027, our focus was on creating more opportunities for travelers by leveraging the complementary strengths of each airline's network while continuing to operate separately," said Drew Wells, Allegiant's chief commercial officer. "These new nonstop routes, combined with our existing scheduled service, give customers more convenient access to the destinations they want to visit most during the busiest travel periods of the year. Just as importantly, these routes are a first look at how we'll create more options, access and value for our customers in the long term."


**Allegiant Air | New Routes for 2027**


The new routes between **Gulf Shores, Alabama** via **Gulf Shores International Airport at Jack Edwards Field (GUF)** and the following cities include:


- **Wichita, Kansas** via **Wichita Dwight D. Eisenhower National Airport (ICT),** which begins May 20, 2027, with one-way fares as low as $49.*
- **Indianapolis, Indiana** via **Indianapolis International Airport (IND),** which begins May 20, 2027, with one-way fares as low as $49.*
- **Little Rock, Arkansas** via **Bill and Hillary Clinton National Airport (LIT),** which begins May 20, 2027, with one-way fares as low as $49.*
- **Shreveport, Louisiana via Shreveport Regional Airport (SHV),** which begins May 20, 2027, with one-way fares as low as $49.*


The new route between **Dulles, Virginia** via **Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD)** and **Orlando, Florida** via **Orlando Sanford International Airport (SFB),** begins May 21, 2027, with one-way fares as low as $49.*


The new route between **Philadelphia, Pennsylvania** via **Philadelphia International Airport (PHL)** and **Destin, Florida via Destin-Fort Walton Beach Airport (VPS),** begins May 21, 2027, with one-way fares as low as $49.*


**Sun Country Airlines | New Routes for 2027**


The new routes between **Chicago, Illinois** via **Chicago O'Hare International Airport (ORD)** and the following cities include:


- **Asheville, North Carolina** via **Asheville Regional Airport (AVL)** which begins May 28, 2027, with one-way fares as low as $49.*
- **Knoxville, Tennessee** via **McGhee Tyson Airport (TYS)** which begins May 27, 2027, with one-way fares as low as $49.*


The new route between **Mesa, Arizona** via **Mesa Gateway Airport (AZA)** and **Salt Lake City, Utah** via **Salt Lake City International Airport (SLC)** begins April 15, 2027, with one-way fares as low as $49.*


The new route between **Belleville, Illinois** via **MidAmerica St. Louis Airport (BLV)** and **Denver, Colorado** via **Denver International Airport (DEN)** begins May 28, 2027, with one-way fares as low as $49.*


The new route between **Minneapolis, Minnesota** via **Minneapolis-Saint Paul International Airport (MSP)** and **Gulf Shores, Alabama** via **Gulf Shores International Airport at Jack Edwards Field (GUF)** begins April 16, 2027, with one-way fares as low as $59.*


**Additional Routes for 2027**


As Allegiant and Sun Country's integration progresses, Allegiant will commence operations on routes between **Minneapolis, Minnesota** via **Minneapolis-Saint Paul International Airport (MSP)** and the following cities:


- **Mesa, Arizona** via **Mesa Gateway Airport (AZA),** with weekly service continuing April 14, 2027.
- **Sarasota, Florida** via **Sarasota Bradenton International Airport (SRQ)** , with weekly service continuing April 14, 2027.
- **Destin, Florida** via **Destin-Fort Walton Beach Airport (VPS),** with weekly service continuing April 14, 2027.
- **Asheville, North Carolina** via **Asheville Regional Airport (AVL)** with weekly service continuing May 28, 2027.


Sun Country will also commence operations on a route between **Cincinnati, Ohio** via **Cincinnati & Northern Kentucky International Airport (CVG)** and **Denver, Colorado** via **Denver International Airport (DEN)** with weekly service continuing May 27, 2027, and one-way fares as low as $49.*


Tickets for all newly announced routes are now available. Flight days, times and the lowest fares can be found at[Allegiant.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4824383-1&h=3123347159&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.allegiant.com%2F&a=Allegiant.com) and[SunCountry.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4824383-1&h=3832065664&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.suncountry.com%2F&a=SunCountry.com) .


***About the introductory one-way fares:**


Seats and dates are limited, and fares are not available on all flights. Flights must be purchased by Nov. 18, 2026, for travel by June 16, 2027. Prices displayed include taxes, carrier charges & government fees. Fare rules, routes and schedules are subject to change without notice. Optional baggage charges and additional restrictions may apply. For more details, optional services and baggage fees, please visit[Allegiant.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4824383-1&h=1525975310&u=http%3A%2F%2Fallegiant.com%2F&a=Allegiant.com) or[SunCountry.com.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4824383-1&h=671816076&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.suncountry.com%2F&a=SunCountry.com.%C2%A0)


**About Allegiant – Together We Fly™**


Las Vegas-based Allegiant (NASDAQ: ALGT) is an integrated travel company with an airline at its heart, focused on connecting customers with the people, places and experiences that matter most. Through Allegiant Air and Sun Country Airlines, the company serves approximately 22 million annual customers across scheduled passenger, charter and cargo operations. Together, the airlines operate more than 650 routes serving nearly 175 cities throughout the United States and select international destinations. Allegiant is committed to providing affordable travel options, operational excellence and long-term value for customers, employees, communities and shareholders. For more information, visit Allegiant.com.
